# telnyx_ai_memory_namespace_settings (Resource)

The settings of an AI memory namespace. Destroy removes them from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy removes the settings from Terraform state only.
resource "telnyx_ai_memory_namespace_settings" "support" {
  namespace = telnyx_ai_memory_namespace.example.name
  summary = {
    instructions = "Remember the customer's products and open tickets."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace.

### Optional

- `summary` (Attributes) A namespace's summary settings, shared by every profile in it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))

<a id="nestedatt--summary"></a>
### Nested Schema for `summary`

Optional:

- `instructions` (String) Free-form instructions that influence how this namespace's summaries are written, shared by every profile in the namespace. How you use them is up to you -- they steer the outcome, so try a phrasing and see how the summary comes out. Advisory: they steer the summary but never override or deny a profile's own facts, and they do not affect recall. Null or empty means none are set, and summaries use the neutral default. A change reaches each summary the next time it is regenerated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_memory_namespace_settings.support <namespace>
```
